# TakeUForward SSN (TUF SSN) — One-Stop Campus Mate & Mentorship Platform

> The premier one-stop campus mate and mentorship platform connecting students, seniors, and alumni at SSN College of Engineering.

## Public Links
- Main Landing / Sign In: https://takeuforward.blastorz.fun/login
- About Platform & Mission: https://takeuforward.blastorz.fun/about
- Alumni Registration: https://takeuforward.blastorz.fun/alumni-invite
- Support & Helpdesk: https://takeuforward.blastorz.fun/support
- Sitemap: https://takeuforward.blastorz.fun/sitemap.xml

## Key Features & Value Proposition

### 1. Server-Side Anonymity Engine
Allows SSN students to post confessions, sensitive questions, and placement doubts with guaranteed server-side identity stripping at the database level.

### 2. Verified Alumni Directory & Mentorship
Connects juniors with vetted SSN alumni for 1:1 mock interviews, career guidance, and corporate job referrals.

### 3. Centralized Academic Repository & AI PDF Summarizer
Centralizes department study materials, previous year question papers (PYQs), notes, and integrates Gemini AI to instantly summarize complex academic PDFs.

### 4. Peer-to-Peer Campus Marketplace & Lost/Found
Dedicated peer-to-peer utility boards for buying/selling second-hand textbooks and returning lost campus items.
